$comment: Template for a per-review manifest. The controller copies this file into <draft-folder>/inputs/_REVIEW-MANIFEST.json and fills the values for the specific review. The orchestrator reads this file at Stage 1 as the authoritative input list. Only fs_draft_pdf is halt-required (invariant rule 15); every other required input degrades with a controller prompt.

fs_draft_pdf.path: <box path or relative path to the draft FS PDF>
fs_draft_pdf.description: The financial statement draft under review. Halt-required (invariant rule 15).

fs_workbook_xlsx.path: <path to the supporting workbook, if available>
fs_workbook_xlsx.description: Excel workbook with the supporting calculation. Used by Mechanical for L8 (hidden-row forensic). Soft-required — degrades L8 with reason_code NO_WORKBOOK if absent.

consolidation_memo.path: <path to the consolidation memo, if applicable>
consolidation_memo.description: Consolidation memo describing the entity tree. Used by Mechanical (cross-statement) and Comparative (L11 multi-entity). Soft-required — degrades L11 if absent.

paths.vpm: <path to Valuation Policy Memo, if available>

policy_memos.description: Fund-specific policy memos. Mechanical uses VPM for L4 compliance and consults the LPA/expense allocation memo for allocation checks. Degrades L4 if VPM absent (reason_code NO_VPM).

lpa_or_fee_summary.path: <path to LPA or distilled fee summary>
lpa_or_fee_summary.description: Used by Narrative for L3 (fee / carried interest narrative). Soft-required — degrades L3 fee-related checks with reason_code NO_LPA if absent.

prior_fs_pdf.description: Prior period FS for L10 comparative. Soft-required — degrades L10 with reason_code NO_PRIOR_FS if absent.

sibling_entity_fs.description: FS of master, feeder, parallel, AIV, or blocker entities for L11. Optional. Each missing entity gets a reason_code NO_SIBLING_FS entry in the coverage manifest.

prior_review_output.path: <path to prior SHINE review output findings.json>
prior_review_output.description: Prior SHINE review findings for prior-review escalation (Stage 5f). Optional — without it, all findings are recurrence NEW.

options.$comment_options: Set to a decimal (e.g., 0.0075) to override the default planning materiality from _FUND-METADATA.json. Leave null to use metadata default.
